The hospital capacity risk calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.76 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. The pytest suite in 'test_output.py' confirmed the logic's correctness with a 100% pass rate. While successful, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules suggest potential environment dependencies to monitor if scaling to AWS-based runtimes.
